summary.zh-CN: 上传文件即可开始：资料研究简报、会议纪要与待办、周报与决策简报、表格核对，结论都指向原文出处。
summary.en: Start from uploaded files: research briefs, meeting minutes and action items, weekly and decision briefs, and table checks, with every conclusion pointing to its source.

now.zh-CN: 多份资料提炼成可追溯简报，区分事实、推断与待核实项
now.en: Turn documents into traceable briefs that separate facts, inferences and open questions

now.zh-CN: 从会议文字稿提取决议与待办，负责人和期限只取原文
now.en: Extract decisions and action items from transcripts; owners and dates only from the text

now.zh-CN: 整理周报、向上汇报与决策简报，数字附来源
now.en: Write weekly reports and decision briefs with sourced numbers

now.zh-CN: 核对表格合计、单位与口径，列出全部差异
now.en: Check totals, units and definitions in tables and list every difference

needs.zh-CN: 会议文字稿、表格、工作记录等文件
needs.en: Transcripts, spreadsheets, work notes and other files

needs.zh-CN: 研究问题、核对范围或简报读者
needs.en: The research question, check scope or brief audience

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide for the task

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：发送邮件、创建日程、改动共享权限
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: sending email, creating calendar events or changing sharing

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型验证：从市场添加、加载到业务、办公协作员上岗后，按会议纪要模板交付结构化纪要与待办。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model on 2026-09-25: added from the market, loaded into a business, and the office collaborator delivered structured minutes and action items from the meeting-minutes template.

conditions.zh-CN: 云盘、邮件与日历连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Cloud drive, mail and calendar connections are optional and not bundled in this version.
